facts.fact: The World Bank paper says that from 2021 to 2025 the Government of Niger ran a rapid drought response pilot under the Wadata Talaka safety net that used satellite data (the WRSI index) to trigger emergency payments, and that it was activated in October 2021 and again in 2023.
The World Bank paper says the WRSI trigger activated emergency payments to 15,400 drought-affected households across 4 communes in October 2021, and that in 2023 this took place in 20 communes.

systems.platform: WRSI from FEWS NET/USGS satellite rainfall estimates
